claim_text: Three additional defendants in the S&S Catering family group (case 22-CR-224), previously listed in this corpus only as 'charged,' pleaded guilty per a Hiiraan Online tracker: Qamar Ahmed Hassan (owner/operator of S&S Catering) pleaded guilty to money laundering and conspiracy to commit wire fraud, admitting she transferred more than $800,000 of S&S Catering's proceeds to her own account for personal purchases including a Jeep Wrangler, a Range Rover, a Brooklyn Park townhome, and an apartment in Nairobi, Kenya; Filsan Mumin Hassan (operator of Youth for Higher Educational Achievement) pleaded guilty to conspiracy to commit wire fraud and money laundering, admitting her company received more than $2.5 million and that she spent $114,000 of it on a Brooklyn Park townhome jointly with Qamar Hassan, and agreed to pay $361,000 in restitution; Abdul Abubakar Ali (co-ran the Youth Inventors Lab food site) pleaded guilty on October 26 to one count of conspiracy to commit wire fraud, admitting the site never served a meal but claimed 1.3 million meals to obtain $3 million.

amounts.methodology: Filsan Mumin Hassan's plea-agreement restitution figure, per Hiiraan Online; not yet confirmed against a primary judgment.

Amount Qamar Ahmed Hassan admitted transferring from S&S Catering's proceeds to her personal account, per Hiiraan Online; not a restitution figure and not independently confirmed against a primary record.

qualifiers: No primary court record has been captured for any of these three defendants; all three dispositions rest on a single secondary journalism source.
Abdul Abubakar Ali's plea date ('October 26') is given without a year in the retrieved source text.

This claim does not update fof-d-030 (Yusuf Bashir Ali); the source's separate 'Yusuf Ali, 41' entry (tied to Youth Inventors Lab, a different shell company) is not confirmed to be the same person and is left unresolved pending further sourcing.
This claim does not affect fof-d-025 (Abdiwahab Ahmed Mohamud), who does not appear by name in the source text and remains 'charged' pending further research.
